title: Carousel Item
description: A content-link to a block that makes sense as a carousel slide (ADR-0020). Deliberately narrower than partials/content-blocks, which answers a different question — 'what can the renderer render here' — and now includes the carousel itself, so reusing it would make a carousel a legal slide of itself. Two nested horizontal scroll containers contend for the same drag and the same touch pan, so the exclusion below is a correctness constraint rather than a matter of taste. Grid and columns are excluded for the plainer reason that neither means anything as a slide.
